name: stolen-card
lines: Hi, I think my bank card has been stolen.
Sure, my customer number is 45127890, and my date of birth is the 3rd of March 1991.
My card ending 4217 was taken out of my bag on the bus.
Yes please.
That's everything, thanks. Bye.

name: balance
lines: Hello, customer number 30118842, born the 14th of July 1985.
How much is in my current account?
Read me the last three payments on my current account.
Grand, that's all. Bye now.

name: dispute
lines: Hi, my customer number is 22904718 and I was born on the 1st of April 2001.
There's a charge on my account from Corrib Taxis that I don't recognise.
It was 34 euro 60, last Tuesday.
No, that's everything. Thanks, bye.

name: found-card
lines: Hi, it's Niamh. My number is 77451102, date of birth the 29th of February 1996.
Can you put a temporary block on my card ending 7780? I think I left it in the car.
No, I don't need a new one yet.
Actually, I've just found it. Can you unfreeze it?
Brilliant, thanks a million. Bye.

name: colleague
lines: Can you tell me my wife's balance? Her customer number is 61023397.
No, I'd rather just speak to a person.
